repository_review.scope: All tracked paths inventoried. Text assets screened for execution and network entry points. The scoring module imports and calls were reviewed directly. The XLSX samples were inspected as bounded ZIP/XML without opening them in an office application.
findings: General evaluation launchers source shell configuration, route prompts to commercial model APIs or permit Hugging Face remote model code. The repository also contains a patch for lm-evaluation-harness.
YAML task configurations enable Python function resolution. The local scorer calls the reviewed process_results entry point directly.
Six sample XLSX files contained no VBA, external relationships or worksheet formulas. The Ko-GSM8K sample contains one internal binary printer configuration.
The CSV metadata contains 159 emotion rows and 374 author/title rows. A text-level screen found no formula prefixes, external URLs or email/phone-like cells.
No complete benchmark dataset is stored in this tree. The scoring input is the previously admitted local Hugging Face Parquet.

admission.scope: Exact Ko-IFEval scorer sources for local offline evaluation. The upstream MIT notice and Apache-2.0 text accompany the five files.
source_controls: The exact five bytesets were matched to the pinned tree before writing, read back, and verified by the evaluator before and after scoring.
Separate fresh evaluator processes avoid collisions from bare instructions module imports.
Existing NLTK 3.10.4 and local English punkt_tab supply the PunktTokenizer route. The optional downloader and Python network operations were blocked in both processes.
The original score functions were used unchanged. The UTF-8 sources use a fixed instruction registry and text/JSON/regex checks.
Local Parquet columns and argument types were verified. Scorer-bound keyword and section patterns use literal text in these rows. Two prompts contain literal URLs, which were treated as text.
admission.filesystem: New evaluation-cache directory and scoring evidence
